look.背景: 天文台が落ちたあと。空気は暗くよどんでいる。

lookRules: 光源は星光。 基調は深い藍と黒、差し色に淡い金と冷たい菫色。夜空をテーマ。明るい場面では星の光そのものを強く輝かせ、その光で画面を照らす。暖色はランプの小さな火だけに許す。炎や日光で明るくしない。
力の見た目は星座の記号で統一する。 力が働いているところには、淡く光る星座の記号が必ず出る。魔法陣や十字などの他の記号は使わない。味方と日常の力は淡い金、凶兆と闇落ち後の力は冷たい菫色。観測の道具（星時計・望遠鏡・アストロラーベ・星図）はすべて真鍮。
ヴァルザの闇落ちで空気を変える。 物語のはじめ、いつもの日常を表現したいときは明るい、素敵な夜空にする。ロマンチックな情景にする。ヴァルザが闇落ちし、町が暗くなったシーンを表現するときは暗く、よどんだ空気にする。
目で描き分ける。 闇落ち後のヴァルザ系は瞼が無く、目を閉じない。ほかのカードは「見上げる」「伏せる」で対比する。

prompt:
Art Style: Japanese anime cel shading. Clean cel shading layered with soft gradients. Confident, crisp linework with thick primary lines and delicate interior detailing. Slightly large eyes with meticulously rendered irises and highlights. Clear skin with minimal shading, and lustrous highlights on the hair. Vivid, highly saturated colors. Facial expressions that are clearly readable. Finished to a quality standard suitable for mobile game key art.
Canvas Use: The illustration must fill the canvas from edge to edge. Do not draw borders, margins, vignetting, or backing paper. Do not place any important elements within 5 percent of any edge. The bottom quarter of the frame will be covered by an effect text banner, so do not place faces or primary subjects there.
Excluded Elements: Do not include text, alphabet letters, numbers, subtitles, signatures, watermarks, or logos. Do not include card frames, borders, UI components, or status icons. Do not create speech bubbles, manga panels, collages, or split screens. Do not depict the same character in multiple poses like a character design sheet.
Appearance: A woman in her early twenties. An impressive woman with glossy long black hair and striking, resolute, almond-shaped amber eyes. Dressed in a one-piece dress with a veil based in purple and gold, wearing a forehead ornament set with jewels. Possessing neat, alluring facial features and a calm smile, exuding a mysterious, noble, and poised atmosphere.
Scene: Framed from the waist up as a bust shot, set against the ruins of a fallen observatory. Do not depict the full body; zoom in so that the face and forehead ornament are the most prominent and eye-catching elements in the frame. Floating above her raised hand is a star-stone larger than her head. The star-stone glows intensely from within, surrounded by a giant ring of constellation symbols slowly rotating around it. Sized to be a co-protagonist in the composition alongside Erna. Erna raises her head to look up at the star-stone, the light illuminating her face. Her eyes are distinctly human. Amidst stagnant surroundings, she carries the atmosphere of someone standing firm to confront the enemy without giving up.
Background: After the observatory has fallen. The air is dark and stagnant.
Shared Deck Visuals: The light source is starlight. Deep indigo and black as the base, accented with pale gold and cold violet. Night sky theme. In bright scenes, let the starlight itself shine intensely to illuminate the canvas. Warm colors are permitted only for small lamp flames. Do not brighten scenes with fire or sunlight. The appearance of power is unified using constellation symbols. Faintly glowing constellation symbols always appear wherever power is active. Do not use other symbols such as magic circles or crosses. The power of allies and ordinary daily life is pale gold, while the power of ill omens and post-corruption is cold violet. All astronomical instruments (star clocks, telescopes, astrolabes, star charts) are brass. Shift the atmosphere with Valza's fall to darkness. When depicting the start of the story and ordinary daily life, make it a bright, wonderful night sky with a romantic atmosphere. When depicting scenes where Valza has fallen to darkness and the town has grown dark, make the air dark and stagnant. Differentiate through the eyes. Figures aligned with Valza after falling to darkness have no eyelids and never close their eyes. Other cards create contrast by having subjects look up or cast their eyes down.
Composition: A slightly vertically oriented illustration of a single leader character. An imposing composition capturing the full body. Easily readable silhouette. The character occupies most of the screen with the head positioned toward the top.
